35 Stat. 2149 (Statutes at Large, govinfo): Proclamation of July 23, 1907, Theodore Roosevelt, Chugach National Forest, Territory of Alaska
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 8979, Dec. 16, 1941, establishing the Kenai National Moose Range

review.note: Extraction error. Executive Order 8979 (Dec. 16, 1941) established the Kenai National Moose Range; it did not establish Chugach. The Chugach National Forest was established by Theodore Roosevelt, Proclamation 770, July 23, 1907, 35 Stat. 2149. Afognak was added by EO 908 in 1908.
